skill.summary: Netlify API integration with managed OAuth. View sites, deploys, builds, DNS zones, and environment variables. Use this skill when users want to view Netlify...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Clarified permissions and user safety: Write operations (site creation, build triggers, env var/DNS changes) now require explicit user approval with specific resource identifiers and confirmation.
- Updated documentation to emphasize default read-only access and caution for high-impact administrative actions.
- Stated that only the documented endpoints should be used (no arbitrary API paths).
- Adjusted skill description and usage guidance to focus on viewing Netlify resources by default; administrative actions are gated behind approval steps.
